cases.given: Two listings share a local symbol but have different MICs.
cases.expected: Resolve only with an explicit listing identity; ambiguous input cannot create a holding.

cases.given: Each of nine listing/source/plan rows is evaluated for six uses.
cases.expected: Unknown scope blocks use. Written evidence enables only the exact named scope.

cases.given: A correction arrives after a forecast origin.
cases.expected: Keep the original manifest immutable; restated evaluation creates a new version.

cases.given: VOD is 125 GBX; a USD 201 value uses GBP 0.80 per USD.
cases.expected: Values are GBP 1.25 andGBP 160.80, with unit conversion applied once.

cases.given: NAV is published late and has no traded bar fields.
cases.expected: Do not invent 30-minute prices; origins wait and cannot consume the NAV before known_at.

cases.given: A DST mismatch week, half-day and holiday affect sessions.
cases.expected: Use the local versioned calendar; do not use fixed UTC offsets or holiday monitoring.

cases.given: Two jobs concurrently request the last five credits.
cases.expected: At most one passes the combined atomic minute/day reservation.

cases.given: A partial batch returns 429 and a request times out before 00:00 UTC.
cases.expected: Keep per-item outcomes and ambiguous liability; daily reset does not erase history.

cases.given: A synthetic fixture runs while live mode is disabled.
cases.expected: Make zero network requests, preserve the mode label and make no live-proof claim.

cases.given: Live receipts for the US, UK and India examples are requested.
cases.expected: Require actual account, named plan, listing, endpoint, intended-use grants, timestamp and delay evidence; these remain pending.

cases.given: A split is announced before its effective date and a dividend is paid later.
cases.expected: Version adjustments as of the cutoff, record cash at the proper date and avoid total-return double counting.

cases.given: A grant is revoked while backups and trained models exist.
cases.expected: Stop new use, invalidate affected derivations and apply the approved retention/disposition policy with protected decision evidence.
